title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.24
body_markdown:
## Case management


- feat(cases): Add case field resolver ([#3405](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3405) )
- feat(cases): Add rich text comments ([#3407](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3407) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Add TableFieldResolver for the shared query model ([#3392](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3392) )
- feat(tables): Add internal row aggregation endpoint ([#3404](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3404) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Resolve dependencies through resource heads ([#3345](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3345) )


## Engine


- feat(engine): Classify sandbox resource-limit failures ([#3406](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3406) )
- fix(engine): Withhold secret-dependent errors ([#3416](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3416) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Remove Glacier transitions from Fargate buckets ([#3415](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3415) )


## Observability


- fix(logging): Capture ActionGateway failures in Sentry ([#3417](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3417) )
